station.name: Lyon-Bron
station.note: 27.6 km NE of the atlas centre of Côte Rôtie. Chosen over Reventin 38336001 (295 m, about 2 km away across the Rhône) because Reventin's temperature and precipitation cover only 2004-2020 and it has no sunshine. Same values as facts/deep-beaujolais.json comparison station.

checked_not_used.Reventin 38336001: 295 m, 45°28'43"N 4°48'38"E, next to the vineyards, but temperature and precipitation 2004-2020 only (rain 775.7 mm, Tmean 12.9 °C), sunshine not available. Not used to avoid mixing periods.
checked_not_used.PNO 2023 production: The INAO PNO file holds a draft cahier with 2009 figures only (about 250 ha in production, about 10,000 hl). Too old, left out.
checked_not_used.Etymology 'roasted slope': No official source fetched, left out.
checked_not_used.Granite: Atlas bedrock says 31% acid plutonic rocks (granite) but the specification names gneiss, micaschist, leucogneiss and migmatite, not granite. Granite not mentioned on screen.

derive_py:
import json,math
lyon_rr=[49.8,41.6,49.4,68.9,80.9,74.1,67.4,65.5,82.5,99.8,87.2,53.7]
lyon_sun=[71.1,102.4,173.7,197.7,223.8,256.5,288.1,263.1,204.1,131.4,78.9,58.7]
lyon_tm=[4.1,5.2,9,12.3,16.3,20.3,22.6,22.3,17.9,13.7,8.1,4.8]
mer_rr=[86.9,66.9,63.3,75.6,71.1,70.4,48.6,56.7,81.2,83.3,114.5,106.4]
mer_sun=[89.8,117.4,170.2,186,220.8,237.7,256,248.8,208.8,150.3,100,84.1]
def hav(a,b,c,d):
    R=6371;p=math.radians
    x=math.sin(p(c-a)/2)**2+math.cos(p(a))*math.cos(p(c))*math.sin(p(d-b)/2)**2
    return 2*R*math.asin(math.sqrt(x))
R_=math.pi/180
def sun(lat,slope,aspect):
    phi=lat*R_;flat=0;tot=0;s=slope*R_;A0=aspect*R_;n=91
    while n<=304:
        dec=23.44*R_*math.sin(2*math.pi*(284+n)/365);t=4
        while t<=20:
            h=(t-12)*15*R_;sa=math.sin(phi)*math.sin(dec)+math.cos(phi)*math.cos(dec)*math.cos(h)
            if sa>0.02:
                ca=math.sqrt(1-sa*sa);A=math.acos(max(-1,min(1,(math.sin(dec)-sa*math.sin(phi))/(ca*math.cos(phi)))))
                if h>0:A=2*math.pi-A
                I=0.7**((1/sa)**0.678);flat+=I*sa
                c=math.cos(s)*sa+math.sin(s)*ca*math.cos(A-A0)
                if c>0:tot+=I*c
            t+=.25
        n+=7
    return tot/flat
blat,blon=45+43/60+16/3600,4+56/60+57/3600
d=dict(lyon_rr_sum=round(sum(lyon_rr),1),mer_rr_sum=round(sum(mer_rr),1),rr_diff=round(sum(mer_rr)-sum(lyon_rr),1),
 lyon_sun_sum=round(sum(lyon_sun),1),mer_sun_sum=round(sum(mer_sun),1),sun_diff=round(sum(mer_sun)-sum(lyon_sun),1),
 lyon_aproct_rr=round(sum(lyon_rr[3:10]),1),lyon_aproct_tmean=round(sum(lyon_tm[3:10])/7,2),
 lyon_son_rr=round(sum(lyon_rr[8:11]),1),
 station_lat=round(blat,4),station_lon=round(blon,4),km_station=round(hav(blat,blon,45.4948,4.805),1),
 relief_m=355-146,sun_slope_se=round(sun(45.49,19.4,152),4),sun_slope_nw=round(sun(45.49,19.4,332),4),
 pct60_deg=round(math.degrees(math.atan(0.60)),1))
print(json.dumps(d,indent=1))
json.dump(d,open('work/deep-cote-rotie/derived.json','w'),indent=1)
